title: Trial, Crucifixion, and Burial

questions.question: When the whole assembly of them brought Jesus before Pilate, what was one of the accusations they made against Him?
options: "We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding us to give tribute to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king."
"He threatened to destroy the temple in three days entirely."
"He cursed the Roman emperor by the false gods of Egypt."
"He is forming a violent army of zealots in the wilderness."
questions.correctAnswer: "We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding us to give tribute to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:2 (ESV): "And they began to accuse him, saying, 'We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding us to give tribute to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.'"

questions.question: When Pilate asked, "Are you the King of the Jews?", Jesus answered him, "___."?
options: "You have said so."
"I am a king, but not of this world entirely."
"No, for my kingdom is in heaven above."
"The Father has made me king recently."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:3 (ESV): "And Pilate asked him, 'Are you the King of the Jews?' And he answered him, 'You have said so.'"

questions.question: Pilate stated he found no guilt in the man. Finding out Jesus was a Galilean, to whom did Pilate send Jesus?
options: Herod
Caiaphas
Augustus
The Sanhedrin officially
questions.explanation: Luke 23:7 (ESV): "And when he learned that he belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him over to Herod, who was himself in Jerusalem at that time."

questions.question: When Herod saw Jesus, he was very glad, for he had long desired to see Him, hoping to see what?
options: Some sign or miracle done by him
Him kneel and beg for mercy immediately
Him curse Pilate and the Roman governor
Him confess to his crimes loudly
questions.correctAnswer: Some sign or miracle done by him
questions.explanation: Luke 23:8 (ESV): "When Herod saw Jesus, he was very glad, for he had long desired to see him... and he was hoping to see some sign done by him."

questions.question: Herod questioned Him at some length, but what did Jesus answer him?
options: He made no answer
"My hour has not yet come."
"You are a fox whom I warned before."
"I speak only to my Father in heaven moving forward."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:9 (ESV): "So he questioned him at some length, but he made no answer."

questions.question: Pilate called together the chief priests, rulers, and people again, stating that neither he nor Herod found Jesus guilty. He offered to punish Him and release Him. Whom did the crowd cry out for instead to be released?
options: Barabbas (who was thrown into prison for insurrection and murder)
Judas the zealot
Gestas the thief
Simon of Cyrene completely
questions.correctAnswer: Barabbas (who was thrown into prison for insurrection and murder)
questions.explanation: Luke 23:18-19 (ESV): "But they all cried out together, 'Away with this man, and release to us Barabbas'—a man who had been thrown into prison for an insurrection..."

questions.question: As they led Jesus away to be crucified, they seized a man and laid the cross on him to carry it behind Jesus. Who was this man?
options: Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country
Joseph of Arimathea entirely
Nicodemus hiding in the crowd
Alexander the metalworker
questions.correctAnswer: Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country
questions.explanation: Luke 23:26 (ESV): "And as they led him away, they seized one Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it behind Jesus."

questions.question: Jesus turned to the women of Jerusalem weeping for Him and told them not to weep for Him, but to weep for themselves and their children. He told them people would say to the mountains, "Fall on us," and to the hills, "___"?
options: "Cover us."
"Crush us completely in an instant."
"Hide us from the wrath securely."
"Rise up and block the armies entirely."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:30 (ESV): "Then they will begin to say to the mountains, 'Fall on us,' and to the hills, 'Cover us.'"

questions.question: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified Him and the two criminals. What did Jesus pray?
options: "Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do."
"Father, curse the Romans holding these nails."
"Father, receive my spirit and shatter the temple."
"Father, why have you forsaken me entirely?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:34 (ESV): "And Jesus said, 'Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do.'" (Some manuscripts omit this sentence).

questions.question: There was an inscription written over Him that said what?
options: "This is the King of the Jews."
"Jesus the Prophet of Nazareth completely."
"The false King claiming a throne."
"He saved others, but cannot save himself."
questions.correctAnswer: "This is the King of the Jews."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:38 (ESV): "There was also an inscription over him, 'This is the King of the Jews.'"

questions.question: One of the criminals rebuked the other who was mocking Jesus, admitting they were justly condemned. Then he said to Jesus, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom." What was Jesus' reply?
options: "Truly, I say to you, today you will be with me in paradise."
"Your faith has saved you, go in peace entirely."
"When the kingdom comes, you shall find rest completely."
"Only angels may enter the kingdom from the highest tree."
questions.correctAnswer: "Truly, I say to you, today you will be with me in paradise."
questions.explanation: Luke 23:43 (ESV): "And he said to him, 'Truly, I say to you, today you will be with me in paradise.'"

questions.question: It was about the sixth hour, and there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour because the sun's light failed. What happened inside the temple?
options: The curtain of the temple was torn in two
The altar crashed violently to the floor
The golden lampstand went completely dark
The holy scrolls burst into blue flame
questions.correctAnswer: The curtain of the temple was torn in two
questions.explanation: Luke 23:45 (ESV): "while the sun's light failed. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two."

questions.question: What were Jesus' final words on the cross before He breathed His last, crying out with a loud voice?
options: "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!"
"It is finished."
"My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
"I thirst immensely for living water."
questions.correctAnswer: "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!"
questions.explanation: Luke 23:46 (ESV): "Then Jesus, calling out with a loud voice, said, 'Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!' And having said this he breathed his last."

questions.question: Who was the good and righteous man, a member of the council who had not consented to their decision, and who asked Pilate for the body of Jesus?
options: Joseph from the Jewish town of Arimathea
Nicodemus openly
Simeon the priest securely
Gamaliel entirely
questions.correctAnswer: Joseph from the Jewish town of Arimathea
questions.explanation: Luke 23:50-52 (ESV): "Now there was a man named Joseph, from the Jewish town of Arimathea... This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus."

questions.question: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a linen shroud, and laid Him where?
options: In a tomb cut in stone, where no one had ever yet been laid
In a shallow grave among the common thieves
In the family tomb of David completely
In a cave previously meant for Lazarus securely
questions.correctAnswer: In a tomb cut in stone, where no one had ever yet been laid
questions.explanation: Luke 23:53 (ESV): "Then he took it down and wrapped it in a linen shroud and laid him in a tomb cut in stone, where no one had ever yet been laid."

key_verse_text: Then Jesus, calling out with a loud voice, said, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!" And having said this he breathed his last.
